baseline.rule: This matrix measures the current shell against the accepted inventory; it does not recreate the inventory.

severity.highest: Can corrupt, duplicate, hide, misrepresent or prevent a normal Chat action.
severity.medium: Usable but materially below the accepted interaction quality.
severity.low: Polish or deliberately deferred breadth with a truthful fallback.

checks.requirement: Replay and live notifications share stable Thread, Turn and item identity; replay never claims live presence.
checks.beforeFinding: Identity was implicit in browser Maps and not executable outside the page; replay/live dedupe had only source-pattern assertions.
checks.implementation: chat-model.mjs canonicalTimeline and applyChatEvent key every transient by compound Thread/Turn/item identity and isolate message, command, tool and delegated collisions.

checks.requirement: item/completed authoritatively replaces accumulated deltas without duplication or stale streaming state.
checks.beforeFinding: The browser implemented replacement but had no reducer-level regression fixture.
checks.implementation: Pure reducer replaces by item id and marks the item non-live.

checks.requirement: Interrupted and failed Turns retain partial history and exactly one terminal boundary.
checks.beforeFinding: Accepted correction already proved real interrupt and replay.
checks.implementation: canonicalTimeline preserves replay items and derives one boundary from authoritative Turn status.

checks.requirement: Incremental paint must not destroy a user's active response selection or disclosure posture.
checks.beforeFinding: Every streamed frame replaced transcript innerHTML, clearing selection and resetting opened activity details.
checks.implementation: Keyed entry reconciliation preserves unchanged DOM nodes and restores focus/disclosures for changed entries; active selection deferral is bounded to 1.2 seconds rather than freezing updates indefinitely.

checks.requirement: Selected Agent text and whole responses can be quoted into the ordinary Composer without turning Chat into a Task.
checks.beforeFinding: Only whole-message Copy existed; selection had no action and streaming could erase it.
checks.implementation: Selection-scoped Add to chat control plus whole-response Quote, compound Thread/Turn/item source identity in browser state, bounded quote chip and Markdown quote transfer into the next normal Turn. Durable quote-source serialization remains a production gap.

checks.requirement: Escape-first Markdown renders readable headings, lists, quotes, links and bounded code without raw HTML.
checks.beforeFinding: Headings, paragraphs, unordered lists, links and code existed; ordered lists, block quotes and code copy did not.
checks.implementation: The extracted escape-first renderer adds ordered lists, block quotes, horizontal rules, focusable code copy and executable adversarial tests. A mature CommonMark renderer remains a medium-severity production gap.

checks.requirement: Memory citations and supported image, audio, skill and mention inputs remain visible with source identity.
checks.beforeFinding: Accepted correction covers citation path, lines, note and source Thread; media inputs are explicit.
checks.implementation: The renderer mounts only supported image sources, shows truthful generated/tool/remote-image fallbacks, and preserves the full citation Thread id accessibly and copyably under aggregate budgets.

checks.requirement: Commands, file changes, tools, plans and delegated work remain subordinate, inspectable, ordered and truthfully live.
checks.beforeFinding: Activity grouping existed, but MCP progress deltas were silently ignored and disclosure posture reset on streamed repaint.
checks.implementation: Reducer handles pinned structured plan, aggregate Turn diff, file output and MCP progress events; stable keyed disclosures survive repaint; typed tool/delegated output stays visible or falls back truthfully.

checks.requirement: Long command, diff, tool and unknown output has a real DOM bound and discloses truncation without mutating durable history.
checks.beforeFinding: CSS bounded visible height but inserted arbitrarily large strings into the DOM.
checks.implementation: One shared render budget caps aggregate mounted text, media, citations and file changes and discloses omissions; app-server replay remains authoritative.

checks.requirement: Command and file approvals route exact pending request identity and exact supported decisions inline.
checks.beforeFinding: Exact request and decisions were already host-routed.
checks.implementation: A pinned-version discriminated registry validates exact decisions; cards expose execution identity and material context and distinguish Decline from Cancel-and-interrupt. Unsupported requests never masquerade as approvals.

checks.requirement: All requestUserInput questions and options render inline, support keyboard operation and return exact answer ids.
checks.beforeFinding: A blocking browser prompt displayed only the first question and discarded rich options.
checks.implementation: Semantic keyed inline form renders every question and exact header, blocking, secret, radio and Other posture; validates every answer id and preserves typed DOM/focus during unrelated streaming patches.

checks.requirement: Text, image and ordinary audio remain available; Composer grows predictably and quote context is removable.
checks.beforeFinding: Attachments and audio worked, but textarea did not resize and quote context was absent.
checks.implementation: Auto-growing textarea, removable quote tray, attachment tray and existing MediaRecorder flow share the ordinary Turn input.

checks.requirement: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line, and Escape interrupts only when Composer owns the active running Turn.
checks.beforeFinding: Enter behavior existed, but Escape only closed overlays and never invoked the documented Stop control.
checks.implementation: Escape delegates to the exact Stop button when no overlay is open, the Turn is trusted running and focus is inside Composer.

checks.requirement: Retrying remains live; a terminal error stays inspectable and retry creates a new Turn rather than rewriting history.
checks.beforeFinding: Retry status rendered, but terminal failure offered no bounded recovery action.
checks.implementation: Authoritative Turn completion retires transient retry/plan/diff/live state; terminal replay produces exactly one boundary. Retry restores the prior human text into Composer and labels the next send as a new Turn.

checks.requirement: A truncated event window, runtime generation change, external request resolution or runtime exit cannot leave false live state.
checks.beforeFinding: The 500-event host window had no oldest cursor/gap signal; runtimeExit and serverRequest/resolved were ignored.
checks.implementation: The host returns oldestCursor, gap, runtimeGeneration and runtimeAlive; the browser disables actions and reconciles before restoring live posture, and removes externally resolved requests.

checks.requirement: Unsupported server requests never appear as approvals or block the Agent indefinitely.
checks.beforeFinding: Every unknown request was labelled as a command approval and item/tool/call could not be resolved.
checks.implementation: The exact registry returns a truthful unsuccessful dynamic-tool response or JSON-RPC method-not-found immediately and records an inspectable bounded event.

checks.requirement: Unknown completed items stay inspectable while unknown deltas do not invent visible lifecycle.
checks.beforeFinding: Fallback existed but raw payload size was unbounded.
checks.implementation: Unknown completed item stays visible; unknown delta is non-mutating; raw disclosure is bounded.

checks.requirement: Search and panels restore focus; all pointer actions have keyboard paths and visible focus.
checks.beforeFinding: Search and Inbox restored focus; requestUserInput used an inaccessible blocking prompt.
checks.implementation: Inline semantic request forms remove the blocking prompt; existing dialog focus return and focus-visible styles remain.

checks.requirement: The same hierarchy works in Light, Dark, desktop and 390x844 without horizontal overflow and honors reduced motion.
checks.beforeFinding: Accepted browser proof covered the prior mixed fixture.
checks.implementation: New quote and inline-input controls use the existing responsive shell; final current-commit browser matrix is recorded separately.

checks.requirement: Production list virtualization replaces the research carrier's bounded tail above 240 items.
checks.beforeFinding: The current carrier intentionally slices to the accepted 240-item tail.
checks.implementation: Executable 240-item and 20k-character bounds are retained; library choice remains a production-shell concern.

checks.requirement: Model and collaboration-mode controls never claim choices the current carrier has not loaded.
checks.beforeFinding: The prototype truthfully labels fixed Agent and Codex posture.
checks.implementation: Production picker remains separate; no false control was added.

checks.requirement: Realtime voice remains hidden when the runtime probe reports unsupported.
checks.beforeFinding: Ordinary audio is supported and realtime is false.
checks.implementation: No false realtime control; ordinary MediaRecorder input remains.
